# **Panel materials**

2018 | 7 | 23 Last compiled: `r Sys.Date()`

**Conventional c-Si**: single-sided monocrystalline or polycrystalline silicon modules, characterised by a single active surface exposed to direct solar radiation. <span style="color:blue">Usually moderate to high shading</span>.

**Bifacial PV**: two active surfaces capable of absorbing not only direct and diffuse radiation, but also that reflected from the ground. <span style="color:blue">Usually low to moderate shading in vertical; moderate to high shading in tilt</span>.

**Semi-tranparent PV**: transmit a significant amount of PAR, while filtering out wavelengths that cannot be used by plants and converting them into electricity. <span style="color:blue">Usually low to moderate shading</span>.

**Concentrating PV**: convey solar radiation to high-efficiency multi-junction cells, allowing the diffuse component of the radiation to pass through to the plants. <span style="color: blue">Designed for low crop light penaty</span>.
